title: Ischemic heart disease
summary: Ischemic heart disease with chest discomfort due to myocardial ischemia, plus one of: positive exercise tolerance test at low workload, three ischemic episodes within 12 months requiring revascularization, or coronary angiography showing significant disease.

children.criterion: Symptoms due to myocardial ischemia (typical angina, atypical angina, or anginal equivalent) while on prescribed treatment
One of: ETT findings, three ischemic episodes, or significant coronary disease on angiography
Sign- or symptom-limited exercise tolerance test demonstrating ischemic findings (ST depression ≥1 mm in non-leads, decrease in BP, abnormal radionuclide uptake) at workload equivalent to ≤5 METs
Three separate ischemic episodes requiring revascularization or unsuccessful revascularization within 12 months

Coronary angiography showing 50% or greater stenosis of left main coronary artery, or 70% or greater stenosis of another non-bypassed coronary artery, or 50% or greater stenosis of a bypass graft, with very serious limitation of ADLs
